items.label: Assignment 2
items.title: Professional Text about Online Shopping
items.description: An analysis of a professional text, a Databoks (Katadata) article on the e-commerce platforms Indonesians use most in 2026, followed by an essay about my own online shopping experience.
points: Purpose, tone and audience of a professional text
Survey data: Shopee 73%, TikTok Shop 16%, Tokopedia 7%
My own experience shopping on Shopee
Advantages and disadvantages of online shopping

excerpt.label: Excerpt · My analysis
excerpt.subject: Databoks (Katadata) · September 2026
body: The article “Shopee Becomes the Most Popular E-Commerce Platform Used by Indonesians in 2026” is an example of professional writing because it presents information about online shopping in Indonesia based on survey data.
**Tone:** professional, objective, and informative, because it reports survey results with numbers and a clear data source, and it avoids emotional or casual language.
Overall, I think online shopping is very useful and convenient, especially for saving time and money.
